summary: This form identifies the neutral state of the represented stop-latch mechanism.
description: This form identifies the neutral state of the represented stop-latch mechanism. Neutral describes the represented retaining mechanism, not every electrical contact belonging to the assembly. A state table provides the relationship between latch condition and contact states.
Identify the associated mechanism and define the neutral condition in its operating sequence. Use separate contact and position references when those interfaces appear elsewhere in the schematic.
readingNotes: Keep neutral and engaged states explicit in state or sequence documentation.
Neutral is a mechanism state, not an assertion that every contact is open.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
